notes.title: Patch November 2024
notes.content:
Changes:

[list]
[*] There is now an extra restart button in the pause menu. Instead of directly restarting when pressing the quick restart button, the pause menu is first opened to prevent accidental restarts.
[*] Minor rebalancing of the hallooween coop mode
[/list]

notes.title: New Coop Mode and Halloween Special
notes.content:
We are proud to annouce the new coop mode. Every game mode is now also playable together with a friend in couch coop.

Additionally, as every year, the halloween mode is available. This time it is available until the 11th November and is of course playable in coop as well.

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added coop modes for every available game mode
[*] Changes to menu for coop mode
[*] Update of the game engine
[*] Fixed a Bug where a Player could get stuck at level 19 in a classic run
[*] Fixed a Bug where a classic run would not restart at the correct level
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween Special
notes.content:
As every halloween, a portal to a dark realm opened in Energy Tail!
A special challenge is waiting for you, with 13 waves - including an evil boss.
Don't forget to try it out, before the portal closes.
According to our estimates, the portal should be stable until the 7th of November.

notes.title: Patch January 2023
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Lower volume for breachlord shots 
[*] Fixed bug in start menu: Level 21 is not selectable any more since it is the breachlord level
[*] Fixed visual bug in final screen: purple tail was too long
[/list]

notes.title: Update November 2022
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Small cooldown added before energy recovers to make the tail less spamable
[*] Spawn rate of tails now depends on existing tail density instead of a fixed timer, which makes it a bit more robust for framerate-issues
[*] Endless Mode is no longer affected by global difficulty setting
[*] Added option to change scaling quality (mostly for fullscreen)
[*] Rebalanced the volume of some sounds
[*] Game does not instantly quit when pressing back/ESC in main menu
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween Special
notes.content:
Greetings!
This halloween, a portal to a dark realm opened in Energy Tail!
A special challenge is waiting for you, with 13 waves - including an evil boss.
Don't forget to try it out, before the portal closes.
According to our estimates, the portal should be stable until the 7th of November.

All Changes:
[list]
[*] New game mode for halloween reachable over the main menu with achievements
[*] Fixing a bug where the player can not reach it's maximum speed when using the gamepad analog stick under some conditions
[/list]

notes.title: Update October 2022
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Main menu changes
[*] Added hints to main menu, to tell the player when locked content gets available
[*] Rebalancing some of the levels
[*] Fixed some sound isseus (Some sounds were too loud in comparison to others)
[/list]
